blurb: Offers a variety of dance and acrobatics classes for ages 2 and up, including ballet, jazz, tap, lyrical, contemporary, hip hop, acro, cheer, and musical theatre. Classes focus on technique, flexibility, strength, and performance skills. Private lessons and themed parties are also available.
